It stays near-silent on bare mentions without such a frame, on repeats and familiar complete names, on fragments split by hyphens, underscores or digit runs (tracking/ATCC accession codes, ALL_CAPS macros, ZIP+4), on two-word Latin species binomials, and on common-noun compounds such as street names.
